versions.content: If the upper layer module requests a cancelation of an ongoing transmission of the Authentic I-PDU by calling SecOC_[If|Tp]CancelTransmit, the SecOC module shall immediately inform the lower layer transport protocol module to cancel the ongoing transmission of the Secured I-PDU, stop all internal actions related to the Authentic I-PDU, and free all related buffers.
